replication.target_description: Pooled one-tailed Pearson correlation between participants’ own age and their estimated age of the ambiguous figure in the primary replication analysis.

es.location: Results, Primary analyses: replication of original findings (canonical HTML text; PDF pagination unavailable)
es.quote:
A one-tailed Pearson correlation was computed between participants’ own-age and their age estimates of the ambiguous figure. Results indicated that there was a significant positive association between participants’ age and their age estimates;
r
(244) = 0.22,
p
< 0.001

notes: Identity independently verified from canonical text: title Age biases the judgment rather than the perception of an ambiguous figure; authors Ambroos Brouwer, Xuxi Jin, Aisha Humaira Waldi and Steven Verheyen; Scientific Reports 11, 8627 (2021); DOI 10.1038/s41598-021-88139-1. Publisher article parse includes Methods, Results, Discussion, references and publication metadata, not merely an abstract or preregistration. No PDF supplied.
